Re arrest of a male Chinese attached to the Shanghai Special Municipality Peace Preservation Corps Headquarters found in possession of an unlicenced Astre Auto Pistol maker's No. 22130 and 27 rounds of ammunition.

At 10 p.m. 26-3-42 S.I.Hide i/c of Lodging House Search Party consisting of S.I.Ching and C.D.S.75 brought to the Station a male Chinese named:-
Shing Ching Kee (邢清記) 35, Hopei,
M/Body-Guard, O.C.L.,

At the Station enquiries conducted by D.P.S.Kobayashi C.D.S.75 and the undersigned ascertained that the arrested person is employed as a bodyguard to one named Zun Nyoh (單耀), 32, Hopei, who holds the rank of Colonel in the aforementioned Corps. He produced an identification card issued by the above Corps which proved his Bona Fides

A subsequent inspection of the Lodging House Books ascertained that the room in which the arrest was effected was opened by Zun Nyoh on the 12-3-42.

All attempts to locate the arrested person's employer having failed, Mr. Oikawa, D.O."A" was communicated with by D.S.Kobayashi 11.20 p.m. and upon being informed of the particulars of the case instructed that he be detained at the Station pending his Master's coming and presenting his Bona-Fides. However at 1.30 a.m. 27-3-42 Mr.S.Haseyama (Japanese Subject) attached to the above mentioned Corps attended this Station, vouched for the detained person's credentials and was allowed to take him from the Station.

In view of the above, the seized pistol and ammunition will be forwarded to the A.I.Section on the A.M. of 27-3-42 for an inspection.

February 14, 1942.

The Shanghai Special Municipality Peace
Preservation Corps - General report.

On June 1, 1941, the General Affairs Department of
the Shanghai Special Municipality Peace Preservation
Corps was established at the Civic Centre, Kiangwan, per
instructions of Mayor Chen Kung-poh, who was appointed on
May 20 by the Executive Yuan of the Nanking Government to
act concurrently as Commander of the Peace Preservation
Corps. Later on July 5, Colonel Loo Ying, Chief of the
Police Bureau, was appointed Vice-Commander.

The Headquarters of the Shanghai Special Municipality
Peace Preservation Corps commenced functioning on August 1,
at the former site of the Police Bureau at Kiangwan. The
strength of the Corps at the end of August 1941 was about
1,200 men.

The Peace Preservation Corps, which is a local
armed force distinct from the army, consists of six
departments, each with a departmental chief in charge.
The Corps, whose powers are similar to those formerly
exercised by the now defunct Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commander's Headquarters under General Yang Hu, assists in
guerilla suppression work, carries out police functions and
has a military court to deal with robbery, kidnapping
and political cases.

It is reported that the Headquarters of the
Shanghai Special Municipality Peace Preservation Corps
will remove in the near future to 57A Great Western Road,
the premises formerly occupied by the Western Area
Special Police Force.

上海特别市保安总队 - 综合报告。

1941年6月1日，根据陈公博市长的指示，上海特别市保安总队总务处在江湾市民中心成立，陈公博市长于5月20日由南京国民政府行政院任命兼任保安总队司令。随后于7月5日，警察局局长陆英 (Loo Ying) 上校被任命为副司令。

上海特别市保安总队总部于8月1日开始在江湾原警察局旧址运作。截至1941年8月底，该总队兵力约为1200人。

保安总队是一支区别于军队的地方武装力量，由六个部门组成，各部门设有主管。该总队的权力类似于前杨虎将军麾下已解散的淞沪卫戍司令部，协助进行游击队肃清工作，履行警察职能，并设有军事法庭处理抢劫、绑架和政治案件。

据报，上海特别市保安总队总部将于近期迁至大西路 (Great Western Road) 57A号，即原西区特种警察部队所占用的 premises。

The Shanghai Special Municipality Peace
Preservation Corps - general report

On June 1, 1941, the General Affairs Department of
the Shanghai Special Municipality Peace Preservation
Corps was established at the Civic Centre, Kiangwan, per
instructions of Mayor Chen Kung-poh, who was appointed on
May 20 by the Executive Yuan of the Nanking Government to
act concurrently as Commander of the Peace Preservation
Corps. Later on July 5, Colonel Loo Ying, Chief of the
Police Bureau, was appointed Vice-Commander.

The Headquarters of the Shanghai Special Municipality
Peace Preservation Corps commenced functioning on August 1,
at the former site of the Police Bureau at Kiangwan. The
strength of the Corps at the end of August 1941 was about
1,200 men.

The Peace Preservation Corps, which is a local
armed force distinct from the army, consists of six
departments, each with a departmental chief in charge.
The Corps, whose powers are similar to those formerly
exercised by the now defunct Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commander's Headquarters under General Yang Hu, assists in
guerilla suppression work, carries out police functions and
has a military court to deal with robbery, kidnapping
and political cases.

For the training of junior officers, the Peace
Preservation Corps organized in the middle of November
last year a "Lower Officers Training Institute" at the
former premises of the Tseng Sz Middle School (正始中學)
on Amherst Avenue, Fahwa Village, in the Western District,
with Mayor Cheng Kung Poh, Commander of the Corps, and
Colonel Loo Ying, Vice-Commander, acting concurrently as
Chief and Deputy Chief respectively at the Institute.

上海特别市保安总队——综合报告

根据陈公博市长（于5月20日由南京政府行政院任命兼任保安总队总队长）的指示，上海特别市保安总队总务处于6月1日在江湾市中心成立。随后于7月5日，警察局局长陆英（Loo Ying，音译）上校被任命为副总队长。

上海特别市保安总队总部于8月1日在江湾原警察局旧址开始运作。截至1941年8月底，该队兵力约为1,200人。

保安总队是一支区别于军队的地方武装力量，下设六个部门，各部均由一名部门主管负责。该队的职权类似于已撤销的杨虎将军麾下的吴淞上海警备司令部，协助进行肃清游击队的工作，履行警察职能，并设有军事法庭审理抢劫、绑架和政治案件。

为了培训初级军官，保安总队于去年11月中旬在西区法华村安和寺路（Amherst Avenue）的原正始中学（Tseng Sz Middle School）校舍成立了“下级军官训练所”，由保安总队总队长陈公博市长和副总队长陆英（Loo Ying，音译）上校分别兼任该所的正、副所长。

The Shanghai Special Municipality Peace Preservation
Corps - Construction and Powers.

The Shanghai Special Municipality Peace Preservation
Corps has a commander, which position is held concurrently
by Mayor Chen Kung Po, and a Vice-Commander, which position
is held concurrently by Loo Ying, Commissioner of the Shanghai
Special Municipal Government Police Bureau.

It has six departments as follows :-
(1). Secretariat.
(2). General Affairs Department.
(3). Staff Department.
(4). Managing Department -- (Distribution of wages and
military supplies.)
(5). Political Training Department.
(6). Military Court.

The Peace Preservation Corps is a local armed force
to supplement the Police strength and is there-fore distinct
from the army. It will assist in guerilla suppression work
and deal with robbery, kidnapping, and political cases which
will be tried by its military court. In brief, the corps
has powers similar to those formerly held by the now defunct
Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commander's Headquarters under
General Yang Hu.

The Shanghai Special Municipality
Peace Preservation Corps.

According to information, the Headquarters of the
Shanghai Special Municipality Peace Preservation Corps
commenced functioning on August 1. Chen Kung Poh, Mayor
of Shanghai and concurrently Commander of the Corps, attended
the Headquarters, which are located at the former site of the
Police Bureau in the Civic Centre, at 10 a.m. August 1, when
he delivered a speech to the Headquarters officials urging
them to adhere to their duties. Commander Chen also announced
that the work will be carried out by two steps, namely, the
reorganization of armed units and the training of officers of
the Corps.

In connection with the reorganization of armed units,
Chen Kung Poh first planned to form four regiments. However,
as no agreement has so far been reached with the Japanese
and owing to the difficult financial problem, it has been
decided that for the first stage the Peace Preservation Corps
will consist of 2,000 men (equal to two regiments). It is
learned that the Police Main Corps under the command of Col.
Loo Ying, which consists of 12 companies, each company
consisting of 108 men, will be reorganized into the Peace
Preservation Corps. If conditions permit, the strength of
the Corps will be increased. The following are the important
officers of the Shanghai Special Municipality Peace Preser-
vation Corps :-

The Shanghai Special Municipality
Peace Preservation Corps.

Information to hand shows that Colonel Loo Ying
(盧英), Chief of the Police Bureau of the Shanghai
Special Municipal Government, was appointed on July 5 by
the Nanking Government concurrently as Vice Commander of
the Shanghai Special Municipality Peace Preservation Corps.

No special preparations have been made, however,
by the General Affairs Department of the Peace Preservation
Corps, which was established on June 1 with a view to
undertaking the formation of the Corps. The Headquarters,
which were originally established in the premises of the
Shanghai Special Municipal Government, have been removed
to the former building of the Police Bureau since July 21,
following the removal of the latter to Nantao. It is
learned that a "General Staff Department" and a "Military
Law Department" have also been established.

According to the plans of Chen Kung Poh, Commander
of the Corps, there will be six departments under the
Headquarters of the Peace Preservation Corps, namely, the
General Affairs Department, the General Staff Department,
the Military Law Department, the Military Supplies Department,
the Surgeons Department and the Adjutants Department.
The Peace Preservation Corps itself will consist of four
regiments. Under each regiment, there will be 3 battalions,
each battalion consisting of 3 companies. There will also
be a special service company under the direct control of the
regimental headquarters. Thus, with each company consisting
of 100 men, the total strength of one regiment, i.e. 10
companies, will be 1,000 men. The following armed units,
it is learned, will form the 4 regiments of the Shanghai

CONFIDENTIAL
June 11, 1941 9155-B(11)
.6 CH

The Shanghai Special Municipality
Peace Preservation Corps - Mayor
Chen appointed Commander.

On May 20, 1941, the Executive Yuan of the Nanking
Government held its 60th meeting, at which the recommen-
dation of Wang Ching Wei, President of the Executive Yuan,
to appoint Chen Kung Poh, Mayor of Shanghai, concurrently
as Commander of the Shanghai Special Municipality Peace
Preservation Corps was passed. Following his appointment,
Mayor Chen instructed the Secretariat of the Shanghai City
Government to form a General Affairs Department of the
Peace Preservation Corps on June 1, so as to start prepara-
tions for the establishment of the Corps.

It is learned that the Special Police Main Corps
now under the City Government Police Bureau will be
reorganized into the Peace Preservation Corps. However, as
the question of the appointment of Vice Commander of the
Corps still remains unsettled, the reorganization of the
Special Police Main Corps has not yet begun.

In regard to the post of Vice Commander of the
Peace Preservation Corps, the Japanese are in favour of
appointing Gen. Loo Ying (盧 英), Chief of the City
Government Police Bureau, but no agreement has, so far,
been reached with the Nanking Government. Hence, it is
believed that the time for the formal establishment of the
Peace Preservation Corps Headquarters will probably be
after the month of September, this year.

Extract from Police Guide and Regulations page 460.
TROOPS. PASSAGE OF THROUGH THE SETTLEMENT.
Permits for the passage of Chinese troops, armed or unarmed,
through the Settlement are issued by the Senior Consul; no unit
or party of Chinese troops is permitted to enter the Settlement
without a permit so issued, and, even if in possession of a
permit, without a police escort.
The first police officer meeting the party will ask for the
production of the permit. If no permit is produced, the party will
be requested to halt pending communication by telephone with the
nearest police station, and thence if necessary, with Headquarters.
Chinese commissioned officers are permitted to wear swords in the
Settlement when making ceremonial calls, and certain Chinese
Officials have written permission to be accompanied by bodyguards,
not exceeding six in number. Such bodyguards are not permitted
to carry arms in the Settlement except when in attendance upon
their masters.
No permit is required for the passage of foreign troops,
but in the case of a large troop movement, the Traffic Office
usually make arrangements for escort, informing the stations
concerned and the Trooper Inspector.

军队。通过租界的通行。
中国军队（无论武装与否）通过租界的通行证由资深领事签发；任何中国军队单位或团体未经签发此类通行证不得进入租界，且即使持有通行证，若无警察护送也不得进入。
遇到该团体的第一位警务人员将要求出示通行证。如果未出示通行证，将要求该团体停留，等待与最近捕房电话联系，并在必要时由此联系总部。
中国委任军官在进行礼节性拜访时，允许在租界内佩带军刀，某些中国官员拥有书面许可，可由不超过六人的保镖陪同。此类保镖除在侍奉主人期间外，不得在租界内携带武器。
外国军队通行无需许可证，但在大规模军队调动的情况下，交通股通常会安排护送，并通知相关捕房及骑警督察。
